scientific.integrity: The standard Hanner construction source, the archived isotropic-constant source, and the closest modern full paper were materially compared. Searches covered exact theorem wording, both endpoint bodies, and the equivalent product/direct-sum recursion. The proof is an exact covariance and beta-integral calculation; finite enumeration is diagnostic only.
limitations: The upper theorem is restricted to Hanner polytopes and does not settle the centrally symmetric strong isotropic conjecture for arbitrary convex bodies.
The lower endpoint is only an extremum inside the Hanner class.
No classification of all intermediate isotropic constants of Hanner construction trees is claimed.
An equivalent elementary recursion may exist in unindexed Banach-space literature.

title: Sharp isotropic-constant range of all Hanner polytopes
